title: Pricey.
text: Pricey.. I was a little worried when I received these two (2) puredown Goose Feather Down pillows. My son has several allergies and I selected these pillows to replace some of his older ones. So far he has not had any issues. I simply inserted them inside hypoallergenic pillow covers before slipping them into cases. He says these pillows are soft and comfortable, just not very full. They are on the thin side. But they are moldable and can be rolled/folded to accommodate your head. For the price (which are a little expensive) they could have been a little thicker/fuller. The cover on them is durable and well made. They fit easily inside standard pillowcases.
